# TESTAI.AZ — AI Educational & Diagnostic Testing Platform

> Curriculum-aligned AI educational testing, diagnostic assessment, and personalized learning analytics platform grounded in official Azerbaijani national school textbooks.

## Platform Mission & Overview
TESTAI.AZ is the pioneer national educational artificial intelligence platform in Azerbaijan. It delivers formative and diagnostic assessments across 14 school subjects (grades 5-11), aligned strictly with Ministry of Science and Education curriculums.

- **Primary URL**: https://www.testai.az
- **Default Languages**: Azerbaijani (az), English (en), Turkish (tr), Russian (ru)
- **Methodology**: SİTG (Milli AI Test Generasiya Standartı) & KAG (Knowledge Augmented Generation)
- **Pedagogy**: Bloom's Taxonomy (Analysis & Application focus), Distractor Analysis, Remediation Knowledge Graphs

## Core Modules & Features
- **Curriculum-Grounded Tests**: Interactive tests generated from official textbooks with zero hallucination guarantee.
- **Diagnostic Cognitive Assessment**: Backward knowledge mapping to identify student learning gaps and root-cause prerequisites.
- **Personalized Analytics**: Visual progress tracking for students, parents, and educators.
- **Pedagogical Blog & Academic Research**: Scientific papers on RAG architecture in education, knowledge ontologies, and diagnostic frameworks.
- **Public Discoveries Catalog**: Open-access curated assessments and educational explorations.
